defs.def: thin hard layer covering the outer tip of the fingers or toes 指甲；趾甲
a small thin pointed piece of metal with a flat head, used for hanging things on a wall or for joining pieces of wood together 钉；钉子

ex.s: He told his father, who said that now the boy should pull out one nail for each day that he was able to hold his temper.
ex.t: 他告诉了他父亲，父亲说现在男孩每能控制住脾气一天就应该拔出一颗钉子。

ex.s: His father gave him a bag of nails and told him that every time he lost his temper, he must hammer a nail into the back of the fence.
ex.t: 他的父亲给了他一袋钉子，告诉他每次发脾气时，他必须在篱笆背面钉一根钉子。

ex.s: The first day, the boy hammered so many nails into the fence that his father had to give him a whole new bag.
ex.t: 第一天，男孩在篱笆上钉了那么多钉子，他父亲只好又给了他一整袋新钉子。

ex.s: Over the next few weeks, as he learnt to control his anger, he hammered fewer and fewer nails into the fence each day.
ex.t: 在接下来的几周里，当他学会控制自己的愤怒时，他每天钉在篱笆上的钉子越来越少。

ex.s: He had learnt that it was easier to hold his temper than to hammer nails into the fence.
ex.t: 他学会了控制脾气比往篱笆上钉钉子更容易。

defs.def: to fasten sth to sth with a nail or nails （用钉子）钉牢，固定
to catch sb and prove they are guilty of a crime or of doing sth bad 抓获并证明有罪；抓住
to prove that sth is not true 证明 … 不属实；揭露；揭发
to achieve sth or do sth right, especially in sport （尤指体育运动中）获得，赢得，击中
to fasten sth down with a nail or nails （用钉子）将 … 钉牢，将 … 固定
to reach an agreement or a decision, usually after a lot of discussion 达成一致；作出决定
to fasten sth to a wall, post, etc. with a nail or nails 用钉子将 … 固定到（墙上、柱子上等）
to put nails into a door or window so that it cannot be opened 用钉子封住，封死（门或窗）
